messages:
Lena Ortiz: Urgent 10: Major prospect NorthWind wants a POC but requires EU-only data processing, BYO-KMS, and a 30% committed discount for a 3-month proof. They want a decision today.
Marcus Bell: 30% is out of my approval band. What's the upside? ARR potential?
Lena Ortiz: They quoted $1.8M ARR if POC converts. Also want a 99.9% uptime during POC.
Riya Kapoor: Technical note: BYO-KMS + EU-only routing doable but will need Private deployment (VPC) or Dedicated with strict routing policy. ETA for Dedicated provisioning ~72 hours once approved.
Sam Holt: Support impact: Dedicated + BYO-KMS increases SLA obligations; we should attach a limited pilot SLA and exclude some entitlements.
Legal Bot: Flag: BYO-KMS requires key escrow and attestation docs. Also need to cap liabilities for POC. Recommend tech addendum.
Marcus Bell: My ceiling is 15% without CRO signoff. Can CRO approve up to 25%?
Riya Kapoor: Alternative: Offer 18% plus guaranteed pilot scope (no model fine-tuning, inference-only) and 48hr provisioning for a hosted-EU fallback while private is stood up. This reduces legal complexity.
Lena Ortiz: Customer insists on BYO-KMS or they won't run the POC. They are sensitive to multi-tenant hosting.
Sam Holt: I'll open infra ticket INF-31011 for Dedicated provisioning and BYO-KMS onboarding. Assign to Riya.
Infra Bot: Created INF-31011: Dedicated + BYO-KMS onboarding. Assigned to Riya Kapoor.
Marcus Bell: Escalating to CRO & CTO for final discount authority. @CRO please advise ASAP; risk of losing deal if we stall.
Lena Ortiz: I'll prepare a 1-pager with cost delta, infra timeline, and risk assessment. Need final guidance within 6 hours.
thread_summary: NorthWind prospect requests EU-only POC with BYO-KMS and 30% discount. Technical team: Dedicated + BYO-KMS possible, ~72hrs provisioning. Finance approval limit 15% without CRO. Infra ticket INF-31011 opened. Action: CRO/CTO decision needed on discount vs. pilot scope.
